title: 内务整洁与防滑倒
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/028_内务整洁与防滑倒.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/028_内务整洁与防滑倒/src.py

points.K1: 杂乱就是危险，内务也是安全
points.K3: 台面只放要用的，东西别放台边
points.K5: 共用设备当天清洁去污
points.K6: 地面不放东西，试剂瓶也不行
points.K9: 洒了马上清理，放提示牌
points.K10: 走路看路，不奔跑，穿防滑鞋
points.K11: 暗室先收线，开辅助照明
points.K12: 防碰撞：伸出的尖角和废料
points.K13: 高柜固定，重物放低，登高用踏凳
points.K14: 摔倒后慢慢起身，清除隐患并报告
points.S1: 值日检查，内务纳入安全检查

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在整洁的实验台旁，拿着扫把向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a tidy lab bench holding a broom, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲内务整洁与防滑倒。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰的实验台堆满器皿，一根电线横过过道
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's bench is cluttered with glassware; a power cord runs across the aisle.
shots.narration: 阿杰的台面堆得满满，电线横过过道。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老周抱着一摞资料进门，脚下被电线绊住
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks in carrying a stack of papers and his foot catches on the cord.
shots.narration: 老周抱着资料进门，被电线绊了一下。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 他向前扑倒，手按向加热板，画面定格打叉
shots.prompt_en: He stumbles forward, his hand heading toward a hot plate; the frame freezes with a red X. No injury shown.
shots.narration: 手差点按在加热板上。

shots.section_title: 杂乱就是危险，内务也是安全
shots.scene: 杂乱的实验室：台面堆满、地上有杂物，红色警示
shots.prompt_en: A messy lab with cluttered benches and items on the floor, tinted with red warning icons. No people.
shots.narration: 杂乱的实验室，就是危险的实验室。
overlay: 杂乱就是危险，内务也是安全

shots.section_title: 杂乱就是危险，内务也是安全
shots.scene: 杂乱带来的三种后果图标：绊倒、碰洒、拿错试剂
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a tripping figure, a knocked-over bottle and a wrong bottle picked up. No text.
shots.narration: 容易绊倒、碰洒，还会拿错试剂。

shots.section_title: 杂乱就是危险，内务也是安全
shots.scene: 王老师带访客参观，指着整洁的通道
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shows a visitor around and points to a clean, clear aisle.
shots.narration: 整理整顿本身就是安全，访客更要照顾到。

shots.section_title: 5S：整理、整顿、清扫、清洁、素养
shots.scene: 五个格子依次亮起：整理、整顿、清扫、清洁、素养
shots.prompt_en: Five boxes light up one by one, each with a simple icon: sorting, arranging, sweeping, standardizing, habit. No text.
shots.narration: 内务管理，可以用5S来做。

shots.section_title: 5S：整理、整顿、清扫、清洁、素养
shots.scene: 整理：坏的、不用的东西清出实验室
shots.prompt_en: Broken and unused items are moved out of the lab into a sorting box. No faces.
shots.narration: 整理：坏的、不用的，清出去。

shots.section_title: 5S：整理、整顿、清扫、清洁、素养
shots.scene: 整顿：物品定点摆放，柜格和地面有定位线
shots.prompt_en: Items placed in marked spots on shelves, with outline markings on the floor for a cart. No text.
shots.narration: 整顿：定点摆放，画好定位线。

shots.section_title: 5S：整理、整顿、清扫、清洁、素养
shots.scene: 清扫：小研擦拭台面和地面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the bench and sweeps the floor.
shots.narration: 清扫：天天打扫，保持干净。

shots.section_title: 5S：整理、整顿、清扫、清洁、素养
shots.scene: 清洁与素养：墙上空白的标准卡，大家每天照做
shots.prompt_en: A blank standard card on the wall; lab members follow it every day.
shots.narration: 定好标准，人人坚持成习惯。

shots.section_title: 台面只放要用的，东西别放台边
shots.scene: 台面上只有本次实验要用的器材，书包放进储物柜
shots.prompt_en: Only the items needed for this experiment are on the bench; a backpack goes into a locker.
shots.narration: 台面只放这次要用的东西。
overlay: 台面只放要用的，东西别放台边

shots.section_title: 台面只放要用的，东西别放台边
shots.scene: 小研退后一步看台面，把不用的器皿和试剂收走
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student steps back to look at her bench and puts away unused glassware and bottles.
shots.narration: 时常退一步，收走不用的器皿试剂。

shots.section_title: 台面只放要用的，东西别放台边
shots.scene: 台边的烧杯被衣袖碰落，打叉；推到台面里侧，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A beaker at the bench edge is knocked off by a sleeve, crossed out; a beaker pushed back from the edge gets a check.
shots.narration: 东西别放台边，往里放。

shots.section_title: 台面只放要用的，东西别放台边
shots.scene: 铁架台放稳，滴定管夹紧
shots.prompt_en: A stable ring stand with a burette firmly clamped on a tidy bench. No people.
shots.narration: 装置放稳夹紧，台面不堆杂物。

shots.section_title: 用完归位，擦净台面
shots.scene: 实验结束，试剂瓶放回原来的储存位置
shots.prompt_en: After the experiment, reagent bottles are returned to their storage places. No faces.
shots.narration: 做完实验，试剂放回原处。

shots.section_title: 用完归位，擦净台面
shots.scene: 【实拍】按本实验室规定的清洁剂擦净台面（手部特写，戴手套）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands wiping a lab bench clean with a cloth.
shots.narration: 按规定擦净台面，器材归位。

shots.section_title: 用完归位，擦净台面
shots.scene: 来不及洗的器皿先泡进洗涤液
shots.prompt_en: Used glassware is soaked in a basin of soapy water. No people.
shots.narration: 器皿来不及洗，先泡起来。

shots.section_title: 用完归位，擦净台面
shots.scene: 气枪吹粉末扬尘打叉，湿纸巾轻轻覆盖收起打勾
shots.prompt_en: Blowing powder with an air gun creates a dust cloud, crossed out; damp towels gently cover and collect it, checked.
shots.narration: 粉末别用气枪吹，覆盖后收起。

shots.section_title: 共用设备当天清洁去污
shots.scene: 共用加热板和搅拌器上有残留
shots.prompt_en: A shared hot plate and stirrer with residue stains on top. No people.
shots.narration: 共用设备最容易积残留。
overlay: 共用设备当天清洁去污

shots.section_title: 共用设备当天清洁去污
shots.scene: 残留混进下一个人的样品，结果出错的示意
shots.prompt_en: Residue particles drift into the next user's sample, and a result chart shows an error mark. No text.
shots.narration: 残留会混进下一个人的实验。

shots.section_title: 共用设备当天清洁去污
shots.scene: 阿杰用完设备，按程序当天清洁去污
shots.prompt_en: The young male student cleans and decontaminates the instrument right after use.
shots.narration: 用完当天去污，替下一个人着想。

shots.section_title: 地面不放东西，试剂瓶也不行
shots.scene: 地上的废纸、包装泡沫让人滑倒，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Waste paper and packing foam on the floor make a figure slip, crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 地上的废纸杂物，会让人滑倒绊倒。
overlay: 地面不放东西，试剂瓶也不行

shots.section_title: 地面不放东西，试剂瓶也不行
shots.scene: 试剂瓶临时放在地上，被脚踢倒，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle set on the floor gets kicked over, crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 试剂瓶不放地上，临时放也不行。

shots.section_title: 地面不放东西，试剂瓶也不行
shots.scene: 拆下的包装材料及时清走
shots.prompt_en: Packing foam and plastic bags are cleared away from a new instrument. No faces.
shots.narration: 包装材料易燃又绊脚，及时清走。

shots.section_title: 通道和门口时刻畅通
shots.scene: 过道和门口被纸箱、椅子挡住，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Boxes and a chair block the aisle and the doorway, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通道和门口，任何时候都要畅通。

shots.section_title: 通道和门口时刻畅通
shots.scene: 绿色箭头沿畅通通道指向出口
shots.prompt_en: Green arrows run along a clear aisle to the exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 出了事，这里就是撤离的路。

shots.section_title: 通道和门口时刻畅通
shots.scene: 阿杰把自己的东西收回柜子，过道清空
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his things back in his cabinet, clearing the aisle.
shots.narration: 自己的东西自己收。

shots.section_title: 通道和门口时刻畅通
shots.scene: 发现乱放的推车，向王老师报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports a misplaced cart to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 看到不安全状况，及时纠正报告。

shots.section_title: 线缆软管不横穿过道
shots.scene: 电线横在干净的地面上，仍然绊人，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A cable lies across an otherwise clean floor and still trips someone, crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 地面再干净，线横过道照样绊人。

shots.section_title: 线缆软管不横穿过道
shots.scene: 线缆沿墙走线，过道上的用线槽盖板盖好
shots.prompt_en: Cables run along the wall, and one crossing the floor is covered by a cable protector ramp. No people.
shots.narration: 线缆沿墙走，或用线槽盖好。

shots.section_title: 线缆软管不横穿过道
shots.scene: 软管和电缆挂在钩上，离开地面
shots.prompt_en: Hoses and cables hang on wall hooks, off the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 软管电缆挂起来，不躺在地上。

shots.section_title: 洒了马上清理，放提示牌
shots.scene: 地上一滩水，旁边有插座和碱液瓶
shots.prompt_en: A puddle of water on the floor near a power outlet and a bottle of alkali. No people.
shots.narration: 一滩水能滑倒人，还可能漏电。
overlay: 洒了马上清理，放提示牌

shots.section_title: 洒了马上清理，放提示牌
shots.scene: 【实拍】地面有清水洒落，先放好小心地滑提示牌（中景，用清水）
shots.prompt_en: A caution wet floor sign is placed beside a small water spill on the lab floor.
shots.narration: 洒了先放好小心地滑提示牌。

shots.section_title: 洒了马上清理，放提示牌
shots.scene: 【实拍】用拖把或吸水材料擦干地面（中景，用清水，示范者穿实验服）
shots.prompt_en: A person in a lab coat mops up the water spill until the floor is dry.
shots.narration: 马上擦干，不留给下一个人。

shots.section_title: 洒了马上清理，放提示牌
shots.scene: 化学品洒落时，按溢洒程序处理的图标
shots.prompt_en: A chemical spill icon beside a spill kit icon and an arrow. No text, no people.
shots.narration: 洒的是化学品，按溢洒程序处理。

shots.section_title: 走路看路，不奔跑，穿防滑鞋
shots.scene: 滑倒、绊倒、跌倒三个人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Three figure icons: slipping, tripping and falling. No text.
shots.narration: 滑倒绊倒，伤害可能很重。
overlay: 走路看路，不奔跑，穿防滑鞋

shots.section_title: 走路看路，不奔跑，穿防滑鞋
shots.scene: 边走边看手机的人被绊，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A person walking while looking at a phone trips on an object, crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 多半因为乱放东西、走路不看路。

shots.section_title: 走路看路，不奔跑，穿防滑鞋
shots.scene: 实验室里奔跑打叉，稳步行走打勾
shots.prompt_en: Running in the lab is crossed out; walking steadily gets a green check. No faces.
shots.narration: 实验室里不奔跑。

shots.section_title: 走路看路，不奔跑，穿防滑鞋
shots.scene: 包脚防滑鞋打勾，拖鞋凉鞋打叉
shots.prompt_en: Closed-toe non-slip shoes get a check; slippers and sandals are crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 穿包脚、防滑的鞋。

shots.section_title: 暗室先收线，开辅助照明
shots.scene: 关灯做光学实验，地上有线缆
shots.prompt_en: A darkened optics lab with cables on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 暗室实验，最怕被绊倒。
overlay: 暗室先收线，开辅助照明

shots.section_title: 暗室先收线，开辅助照明
shots.scene: 关灯前收好线缆，清空通道
shots.prompt_en: Before switching off the lights, the female graduate student coils the cables and clears the path.
shots.narration: 关灯前，收好线缆，清空通道。

shots.section_title: 暗室先收线，开辅助照明
shots.scene: 留一盏弱光，出口标志亮着
shots.prompt_en: A dim auxiliary lamp stays on and a lit emergency exit sign glows. No people.
shots.narration: 留一盏弱光，出口标志要亮。

shots.section_title: 防碰撞：伸出的尖角和废料
shots.scene: 架子伸出的板角正在头部高度，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A board corner sticks out from a shelf at head height, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 伸到头高的板角，切掉或收好。
overlay: 防碰撞：伸出的尖角和废料

shots.section_title: 防碰撞：伸出的尖角和废料
shots.scene: 废料桶放在台边挡道，尖角伸出桶外，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A scrap bin sits by the bench in the walkway with sharp pieces sticking out, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 废料不伸出桶外，桶不挡道。

shots.section_title: 防碰撞：伸出的尖角和废料
shots.scene: 长条废料竖放在架子里，用链条拦住
shots.prompt_en: Long scrap pieces stand upright in a rack, secured with a chain across. No people.
shots.narration: 长料竖放上架，拦好防倒。

shots.section_title: 防碰撞：伸出的尖角和废料
shots.scene: 阿杰低头起身时注意头顶的柜门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rises carefully, watching out for an open cabinet door above.
shots.narration: 留意周围，小心架子和柜门碰头。

shots.section_title: 高柜固定，重物放低，登高用踏凳
shots.scene: 高高的试剂架用固定件固定在墙上
shots.prompt_en: A tall reagent shelf is anchored to the wall with brackets. No people.
shots.narration: 高柜和试剂架，固定在墙上。
overlay: 高柜固定，重物放低，登高用踏凳

shots.section_title: 高柜固定，重物放低，登高用踏凳
shots.scene: 重物和液体放下层，轻的放上层
shots.prompt_en: Heavy items and liquid bottles on the lower shelves, light items on top. No people.
shots.narration: 重的、装液体的，放在下层。

shots.section_title: 高柜固定，重物放低，登高用踏凳
shots.scene: 站转椅取物打叉，用稳固踏凳打勾
shots.prompt_en: Standing on a swivel chair to reach a shelf is crossed out; using a sturdy step stool gets a check. No faces.
shots.narration: 取高处不站转椅，用稳固踏凳。

shots.section_title: 摔倒后慢慢起身，清除隐患并报告
shots.scene: 摔倒的人坐在地上，先停一下感觉身体
shots.prompt_en: A person who slipped sits on the floor and pauses to check how they feel. No faces.
shots.narration: 摔倒了，先别急着站起来。
overlay: 摔倒后慢慢起身，清除隐患并报告

shots.section_title: 摔倒后慢慢起身，清除隐患并报告
shots.scene: 扶着台面慢慢站起来
shots.prompt_en: The person holds onto the bench and slowly gets up. No faces.
shots.narration: 没事的话，扶着东西慢慢起来。

shots.section_title: 摔倒后慢慢起身，清除隐患并报告
shots.scene: 把地面弄干，并报告实验室负责人
shots.prompt_en: The floor is dried and the person reports to the older man.
shots.narration: 清除隐患，报告负责人，别让人再摔。

shots.section_title: 值日检查，内务纳入安全检查
shots.scene: 墙上的值日表和检查表，大家轮流打扫
shots.prompt_en: A blank duty roster and checklist on the wall; lab members take turns cleaning.
shots.narration: 实验室排好值日，下班前检查。
overlay: 值日检查，内务纳入安全检查

shots.section_title: 值日检查，内务纳入安全检查
shots.scene: 王老师对照检查表查看台面、通道和地面
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator inspects benches, aisles and floors against a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 学校安全检查，内务是必查项。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 整洁台面、畅通通道、干燥地面依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: A tidy bench, a clear aisle and a dry floor get green checks one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 台面整洁，通道畅通，地面干燥。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 线缆收好、提示牌、防滑鞋依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Neatly routed cables, a wet floor sign and non-slip shoes get green checks one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 线缆收好，洒了即清，看路慢行。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个装碎玻璃的专用纸盒，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a sturdy broken-glass disposal box and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲锐器与碎玻璃安全。
